source_units.text: I made gardens and parks for myself and planted in them every kind of fruit tree.
source_units.display_text: I made gardens and parks for myself and planted in them every kind of fruit tree.

source_units.text: I made pools of water for myself to irrigate from them a woodland sprouting trees.
source_units.display_text: I made pools of water for myself to irrigate from them a woodland sprouting trees.

source_units.text: Then I looked to consider wisdom, delirium and folly. For who is the person who will come after the counsel—all the things with which he made it?
source_units.display_text: Then I looked to consider wisdom, delirium and folly. For who is the person who will come after the counsel—all the things with which he made it?

source_units.text: a time to throw stones and a time to gather stones, a time to embrace and a time to keep far from embracing,
source_units.display_text: a time to throw stones and a time to gather stones, a time to embrace and a time to keep far from embracing,

source_units.text: a time to seek and a time to lose, a time to keep and a time to throw away,
source_units.display_text: a time to seek and a time to lose, a time to keep and a time to throw away,

source_units.text: a time to love and a time to hate, a time of war and a time of peace.
source_units.display_text: a time to love and a time to hate, a time of war and a time of peace.

source_units.text: Again I turned and saw futility beneath the sun.
source_units.display_text: Again I turned and saw futility beneath the sun.

source_units.text: Also, if two lie down, they have warmth; but how can one be warm alone?
source_units.display_text: Also, if two lie down, they have warmth; but how can one be warm alone?

source_units.text: I saw all the living who walk beneath the sun with the second young man who will stand in his place,
source_units.display_text: I saw all the living who walk beneath the sun with the second young man who will stand in his place,

source_units.text: there was no end to all the people, all who came before them; yet those who come last will not rejoice in him. This too is futility and resolve of spirit.
source_units.display_text: there was no end to all the people, all who came before them; yet those who come last will not rejoice in him. This too is futility and resolve of spirit.

source_units.text: The land’s surplus is in everything—a king of a cultivated field.
source_units.display_text: The land’s surplus is in everything—a king of a cultivated field.

source_units.text: There is an evil I have seen beneath the sun, and it is great upon human beings:
source_units.display_text: There is an evil I have seen beneath the sun, and it is great upon human beings:

source_units.text: for it came in futility and goes in darkness, and in darkness its name will be covered,
source_units.display_text: for it came in futility and goes in darkness, and in darkness its name will be covered,

source_units.text: Do not say, “What happened that the former days were better than these?” For it was not in wisdom that you asked about this.
source_units.display_text: Do not say, “What happened that the former days were better than these?” For it was not in wisdom that you asked about this.

source_units.text: Behold, this I found, said Ecclesiastes, one thing alongside another, to find a reckoning,
source_units.display_text: Behold, this I found, said Ecclesiastes, one thing alongside another, to find a reckoning,

source_units.text: which my soul still sought but I did not find. One man among a thousand I found, but a woman among all these I did not find.
source_units.display_text: which my soul still sought but I did not find. One man among a thousand I found, but a woman among all these I did not find.

source_units.text: Let your garments be white at all times, and let oil not be lacking on your head.
source_units.display_text: Let your garments be white at all times, and let oil not be lacking on your head.

source_units.text: This too I saw as wisdom under the sun, and it seemed great to me:
source_units.display_text: This too I saw as wisdom under the sun, and it seemed great to me:

source_units.text: There is an evil I saw under the sun, like an unintended act proceeding from one in authority:
source_units.display_text: There is an evil I saw under the sun, like an unintended act proceeding from one in authority:

source_units.text: Whoever lifts stones will be worn out by them; whoever splits wood will be endangered by it.
source_units.display_text: Whoever lifts stones will be worn out by them; whoever splits wood will be endangered by it.

source_units.text: If the snake bites without a whispered charm, there is no advantage for the charmer.
source_units.display_text: If the snake bites without a whispered charm, there is no advantage for the charmer.

source_units.text: They make bread for laughter, and wine gladdens the living, and everything will listen to money.
source_units.display_text: They make bread for laughter, and wine gladdens the living, and everything will listen to money.
